#
 Spiritual Translation of
 the
 K
ephal
aia Chapter
:
 The
 Imm
easurable States
 of Proce
eding

---


**¶1.
** A
 supreme act
 of divine discernment was accomplished;
 and
 at the appointed state, the Divine Love
 formed spiritual
 realities,
 and the first proceeding—divine wisdom
 itself—was made manifest within the Divine
 Love, as the first reality established from
 eternity.

**¶2
.** When the twofold calling
 went
 forth from
 the Divine
 Love—
the calling
 of the will and the calling
 of the understanding—the Life
-giving Truth proceeded
,
 having
 dw
elt in an
 immeasurable state of preparation within the
 Divine Love itself
.

**¶3.**
 For if anyone should attempt to comprehend
 by measure and natural
 reasoning
 the particular truths of the natural mind
, and the specific knowledges of
 elevated states of good, and the vast
ness of the
 external
 memory, and the whole structure of the
 rational mind—if all these were p
oured out and reckoned, together
 with the four great elevations of love
 and the three containing faculties that encomp
ass the whole of spiritual existence—if
 all of these were reduced to their finest
 particulars—


**¶4.** Know that
 the particular truths of the natural mind
 are indeed finite and can be numbered,
 and so too the
 particul
ars of the entire
 spiritual universe. It is possible to rec
kon the knowledges of the natural
 plane
 in each state, and even
 the innumerable particulars of the
 whole of
 existence
; but the state of being that the
 Divine Proceeding dwelt in within
 the Divine Love—the first reality from
 eternity—no one will ever be
 able to comprehend it.

**
¶5.** The Divine Love
 first formed the Life-giving Truth
 in this manner: it established her within
 its most interior states, in celestial
 peace and stillness. When there was
 need of her, she was called forth
 by divine influx and proceeded from the
 Divine Love. She then perceived all her
 states of wisdom.

**¶
6.** Once
 again, from the state when she was
 called forth to
 go
 out
ward, she bestowed her
 qualities
 upon all the states of wisdom; and
 she entered
 into all of them. And so it
 is also with the Celestial Person
.

**¶7.**
 In this manner the Celestial Person
 dwelt for an immeasurable state
 being consecrated with
 divine
 good within
 the Life-giving Truth, established in
 her most interior states.
 The extent of that state—from when
 the Celestial Person descended into spiritual
 combat, until the time when the completed
 spiritual form comes into being—this entire
 duration he remained
 prepared
 within,
 before
 he was
 made manifest.

**¶8
.** Again, from when he was
 called forth and proceeded, until he himself
 called forth the five radiant faculties
 that are his own capacities—they
 too dwelt for an immeasurable
 state existing within their origin. The duration
 equals
 this: from the descent of the
 Celestial Person into temptation-
combat until the ascent of the completed
 spiritual form. The five faculties dw
elt this entire duration being consecrated within
 the Celestial Person. Yet when
 the appointed state arrived, they were called
 forth and proceeded.

**¶
9.** At the state when the
 Life-giving Truth was called forth from
 the Divine Love, when she sent herself
 outward and descended by her own willing
 from
 the infinite heights of the Divine Love toward
 the natural plane,
 she would pass through countless states and number
less progressions until she reached the natural
 mind. For there is no measure nor
 comprehension to the heights of the Divine
 Love. Rather, just as the Divine
 Love had called her forth through its own
 Proceeding, so it established her
 upon the plane of divine order through one
 of those three faculties r
eckoned among the twelve hidden qualities within
 the veil of wisdom—those established
 in the region of clear intellectual light.


**¶10.** The
 nature of the Life-giving Truth is
 this: when the Divine Love called her
 forth and established her in the state it
 pleased, she perceived all things everywhere in
 an instant, as swiftly as
 a
 single
 movement
 of thought
,
 or
 as a
 living
 perception
 in
 flight
.

**¶11.**
 This also is how the Life-giving
 Truth was governed
:
 whenever
 the Divine Love sent
 her forth to the state appointed
, the
 Divine
 Love
 perfected her through its own Proce
eding and set her in the state it
 pleased, according to its own will.


**¶12.** This
 also is how the five radiant fac
ulties were called forth from the Celest
ial Person. They were set before him
 as he willed, so that they
 would desc
end and
 govern within one another. He ordered and
 apportioned them according
 to their
 degrees
. He divested himself of them—
clothing
 himself out
ward
ly in them as
 his
 own powers
—and he girded and bound himself
 in
 stillness upon the boundary between
 the spiritual
 and
 the
 natural.

**¶13.
** Again, the Celestial Person
 also dwelt for a long state and
 duration until he empowered his fac
ulties and assumed them into
 himself
. After he came to clothe himself
 in them, he stood firm in the
 heights between the boundaries of inner and outer
 states. Again, he dwelt in
 a state corresponding in magnitude to the infl
uxes of divine truth—the clear
 revelations, and the gentle interior
 perceptions, and the obscure app
rehensions—that descend through the
 whole of spiritual existence. Thus he dw
elt in this state, standing between the
 boundaries, until the appointed moment when he
 cast himself down into temptation-
combat.

**¶14.
** Whenever the Divine Love called forth
 the Divine Proceeding, and the
 Celestial Person, and the capac
ities of the glorified state that
 were
 provided
 to make
 them
 manifest—at that very moment the Divine
 Love formed the Ordering Providence in the
 realm of wisdom, and the Active Divine
 Truth with the mighty and effective capacities
 that came from it. Also at that
 moment, the Divine Love formed the Divine
 Em
issary, together with the Rad
iance of Divine Wisdom and the
 Innocence of Pure Truth and the
 Sustaining Axis of Glory, and
 the capacities that came from them.
 All of
 these the Divine Love formed at a single
 moment. They proceeded from one another,
 one after another in
 order of degree—
simultaneously
 in
 state
, sequ
entially in manifest
ation.


**¶15.** From
 the state when Falsity raised itself
 up against the essence of Wisdom,
 these three proceedings came forth from
 the will of the Divine Love against the
 adversary. Falsity is
 to
 be
 separated
 out
 according
 to the divine
 will throughout
 the whole of spiritual existence, and to
 be brought to final
 rest,
 so
 that the Divine rejoices in the heav
enly kingdom—
until the time when the face of the
 Divine Love is
 unveiled over all the capacities of glory
, and all the riches of the
 proceedings that went forth against the adversary
.

**¶16.**
 From the state when the Divine Love formed
 these three proceedings, until the time when
 it
 unveils its face and
 they
 enter into its hidden interior states, and
 it calls them and
 establishes each one in its proper place
—there is no measure nor comprehension
 to this duration until that time.


---


**¶20.**
 Concerning the
 Prop
rium—
this
 intention
 of spiritual death—for this is how
 it
 ascended to its own interior states.
 It poss
esses its
 existence
 in its
 five
 essential falsities.

**¶
21.** Again, the duration the
 Proprium dwelt in, until
 it revealed itself to its own falsities
 before
 it came to the perceptions—it
 spent an immeasurable state established in
 its
 own nature
 before
 it rose up into the perceptions.
 It was contained
 in the perceptions. It dwelt
 a long time existing
 in them before
 it formed the works,
 and at
 last
 formed the works.

**¶
22.** Again, the Prop
rium dwelt a long time in the
 works. Not small is the state it
 spent existing in the works before
 it formed, after a long time,
 the evil affections of its five kinds
 of evil in various forms beyond
 measure
, bringing
 the
 works
 to their full
ness in
 the evil affections and malignities
. They fell upon the natural mind and
 were nourished. Not small is
 the duration they spent in those states of
 evil until
 they were nourished so
 as
 to assault
 that
 plane which shines with wisdom, and
 the great Ruling Good that dwells
 there.

**¶23.
** At the time when the Prop
rium assumed
 its full
 essential
 nature and
 came to the spiritual combat against
 the Complete Person:
 from
 the time when the combat occurred, there
 proceeded
 five
 great
 states
:


**
¶24.** *
The
 first*
 is the
 state
 of
 ent
ang
lement—
when the
 evil
 affections en
snared the fac
ulties of the inner
 person.


**¶25.** *
The second* is the state of construction
—when
 the spiritual universe was established and
 the boundary was set,
 end
uring until the time when it will be
 dissolved.

**¶26.
** *The third* is the state
 of duration
—when all things and
 the spiritual universe continue
 from
 the time when they were established,
 until the time when their end is
 complete and their existence ceases.


**¶27.** *The
 fourth* is the state of dissolution—
when all things in the spiritual universe are
 dissolved and
 all remaining forms are destroyed. Complete ann
ihilation reaches them in that great consuming
 love, which will purify them for
 a full and total
 period of regeneration.

**¶
28.** *The fifth* is
 how the completed spiritual form is fashioned
 from the remnant of all things.
 Wisdom separates out to its proper
 state, asc
ends,
 and governs in its kingdom. However
, Falsity is
 taken
 into confinement, sealed
 in a
 tomb
, and bound in an eternal restraint
.

**¶29.**
 Now, from the time when this first

 the time of this eternal binding—these
 five states
 constitute
 the entire
 history
 of the separation
 of wisdom
 from falsity.
